messages:
sara: Scheduling a short rehearsal for the Priority Fallback policy next Mon 01:00-02:30 UTC. Purpose: validate tiered fallback (priority->reserved, standard->quantized-shared, best-effort->throttle) and the rollback gates when under burst. NOT changing live weights, will use test-flag routing. TL;DR: feature-flag rollout + synthetic spike per tier + verify client messaging.

milo: Quick why: we want confidence that customers observing 'priority' SLOs get preserved while best-effort tenants get graceful throttling, and that our rollback/playbooks work end-to-end.

dinesh: Plan: 00:30 preflight (prewarm KV + bump reserved min + enable flag in canary), 01:00 start tiered synthetic traffic (three tags: priority/standard/besteffort), 01:20 enable soft-fallback behavior, 01:40 scale observation and run fallback stress for 15m, 02:00 cooldown + gather traces, 02:15 quick postmortem. Rollback: immediate flag-off on hard trigger OR step down to partial fallback on soft.

sara: Hard triggers: any sustained p99(priority) > 260ms for 5m OR priority error rate > 0.5% 3m. Soft triggers: standard p99 > 300ms 3m OR best-effort error > 1% 3m -> engage partial fallback (increase throttle on best-effort, shift standard to quantized pool).

eva: Routing test snippet (proxy):
```
route "priority-test" {
  match: header(x-tenant-priority) in ["priority","standard","besteffort"]
  flag: "tiered-fallback-test"
  rules: when flag==true -> apply tiered-actions
}
```
I'll push the flag to 4 canaries in us-west first.

milo: Fallback actions (sketch): priority -> reserved(100%), standard -> quantized-shared(70%)/shared(30%), besteffort -> shared with throttle 80rps per-tenant + Retry-After. Will post full JSON to runbook.

dinesh: Observability checklist: - create metrics namespace "tiered-dryrun" - three synthetic clients across regions tagging priority headers - set trace sampling 100% for priority and 50% for others for first 30m - dashboards for p99 per-tier and per-pool CPU/mem. Alerts: priority.p99 > 220ms (warn), >260ms (hard); standard.p99 > 300ms; besteffort.error > 1%.

sara: Support and comms: @support-lead please prepare canned messages for each tier (fallback, throttle, restored) so CS can respond if customers notice.

support-lead: Will draft three short templates and upload to #support-templates. Also will staff one senior rep during window.

deploy-bot: Maintenance scheduled: tiered-fallback-rehearsal by sara on 2678901234 (Mon 01:00-02:30 UTC). Notified groups: eng-sre, eng-runtime, product, support.

dinesh: Loadtest commands (from loadtest cluster):
```
# priority stream
./tools/loadtest --tag tiered-priority --qps 300 --duration 25m --header "x-tenant-priority: priority"
# standard stream
./tools/loadtest --tag tiered-standard --qps 600 --duration 25m --header "x-tenant-priority: standard"
# besteffort stream
./tools/loadtest --tag tiered-besteffort --qps 400 --duration 25m --header "x-tenant-priority: besteffort"
```
We'll run global at 01:05 and a regional spike at 01:35 against ap-south.

milo: Autoscaler note: reserved pool min +25% at 00:45; quantized-shared pool mark scale.probe=true so it reacts to quantized load. I'll set these and post PR.

eva: PR: https://intranet.redwood/ops/changes/PR-4823 (flag + proxy rules)

sara: Runbook link: https://intranet.redwood/sre/runbooks/tiered-fallback-rehearsal — added fallback JSON and rollback checklist.

dinesh: Small change: ensure metrics isolation for the rehearsal (suffix .dryrun) so normal alerts don't fire. Also add a burn-rate suppression rule for rehearsal window.

sara: Team owners: @milo proxy + autoscaler preflight, @dinesh observability + loadtests, @eva flag rollout, @support-lead customer comms. I'll own postmortem. Be concise in-thread during window. :white_check_mark:
